messages:
nora: Quick weekly health check for BlueArc onboarding cohort 10. Snapshot: p95/p99 by route & model, streaming vs non-streaming. Noting a sustained p99 skew on /chat-complete streaming since ~03:00 UTC. TL;DR: onboarding usage looks healthy but tail risk could impact renewal conversation if it persists.

ben: can you drop the numbers and any error/spend signals?

nora: pasted telemetry snapshot (raw numbers from last 24h):

```
Route: /chat-complete
Model: redwood-pro-1
Streaming: p95 180ms, p99 980ms
Non-streaming: p95 360ms, p99 2,400ms

Route: /summarize
Model: open-slim-2
Streaming: p95 120ms, p99 520ms
Non-streaming: p95 290ms, p99 1,100ms

Errors: overall 1.1% (timeouts + retries concentrated on /chat-complete streaming)
Spend: +9% WoW (retries + a few long-tail requests)
Usage: tokens +22% WoW (onboarding bots + test harness)
```

sasha: quick trace check 1: long tails line up with large KV windows (>=7k tokens) and queue pileup on rpool-7. Batcher queue length peaked ~1.2k at 03:20 UTC. see trace: https://dash.redwood/trace/BA-789

james: confirmed infra correlation. last config change to rpool-7 set aggressive throughput mode: `batch_size: 192`, `max_delay_ms: 20` (intended for high throughput clients). that hurts low-latency streaming p99 when KV hits are large. prepping a conservative patch to add low-latency pod class and reduce `batch_size` to 48 for that slice.

ops-bot: Deploybot: rollout scheduled by james. Patch id db-2026-03-20T04:05Z 1 low-latency slice creation + batch_size => 48.

ben: immediate mitigation we can do customer-side? caching?

sasha: yes, prefix/KV caching would avoid repeated KV reads from the same onboarding flows. also enabling per-account small-context policy to cap batcher eligibility for >6k token requests.

james: plan: 1) roll low-latency slice (ops) 2) enable prefix cache for BlueArc (sasha) 3) add probe to monitor /chat-complete p95/p99 and error rate (nora). will also schedule a 15-min renewal-risk sync with BlueArc CSM.

nora: assigning: ops=james, cache roll=sasha, probes/me customer note = nora. I'll upload the weekly CSV and tag this account as `watch` for the renewal dashboard if tails don't fall below target in 48h.

james: post-rollout quick-look (0-20m): streaming /chat-complete p99 down to ~560ms, non-streaming p99 ~1,250ms. still above ideal but ~55% reduction on tail.

ben: good improvement. sasha, when will caching be live?

sasha: feature-flagging to 10% of BlueArc traffic now, then ramp to 100% over 2h if probe metrics look good. will post +2h snapshot.

nora: thanks all. I'll prepare a short customer-facing summary for the CSM with the 48h plan and follow-up metrics. Closing this thread when 48h stable. :white_check_mark:
